archiveContract.otherDeclarations: The final scope, executable replay manifest, validation contract and this preparation receipt are frozen as exact inputs.
archiveContract.journalPolicy: Historical replay baseline/trace files and actual-operation journals are neither opened nor archived by scope validation; only the explicit Binding fixture is included.
archiveContract.sourceIntegrity: Declaration SHA256 values bind the exact bounded bytes validated; the first archive baseline must match them. All member hashes are checked during writing and after writing. Final helper membership and declaration pins are rechecked, and native_source must remain equal.
archiveContract.immutability: Existing manifest/archive/parts are refused. Every output is exclusive. Ordered900000-byte parts reconstruct exact original bytes.
